summary: Implemented the doctor host-check suite with ordered Podman/version, rootless, lingering, git, Node, and disk checks, human and schemaVersion 1 JSON output, exit 0/2 behavior, and injectable process/clock/disk fakes. Typecheck, lint, focused (26 tests), full unit suite (99 tests), build, and manual CLI checks all pass.

decisions: Added the Node.js 24 check alongside git per feature open question 1.
Skip is a non-pass status: it requires remediation, makes the overall result warn, and still exits 0.
A missing Podman binary makes the rootless check skip; a timeout or other spawn failure is a fail, not a missing binary.
Distro guidance is selected from injected /etc/os-release data, defaulting to the distribution's package manager.
Doctor uses a narrow injectable synchronous spawn adapter until the shared platform runner exists.
interfaces: DoctorCheck { id, label, status, detail, remediation }
DoctorDocument { schemaVersion: 1, status, checks: [{ id, status, detail, remediation }] }
agentReportedTests: manual --help/version/doctor/doctor --json: exit 0, doctor completed in 1.14 s
warnings: doctor --json introduces the stable document {schemaVersion, status, checks}; docs must reflect the check IDs and remediation null semantics.
The default doctor process adapter is local to the doctor module until platform-engineer's shared runner is available; it remains replaceable by injection.
payload.taskDescription: Add doctor with an ordered check list covering Podman presence and version, rootless mode, user lingering, git version, and free disk space. Each check returns pass, warn, fail, or skip with a detail line and a remediation line. Doctor exits 0 when all checks pass or warn and 2 when any check fails. Support --json with schemaVersion 1, a checks array, and an overall status. Tests inject a recording process runner and cover Podman missing, Podman 4.9.3, Podman 5.7.0 rootless, Podman 5.8.9 rootless, Podman 6.1.4 rejection, lingering disabled, git too old, low disk, all-pass output, JSON shape, and the 2-second no-network budget using a fake clock.
